description: List US drilling permits from state regulators across one or more states and an optional permit-date range, newest permit date first, paged up to 100 rows per page. Each row has the permit date, state, county, operator, well, permit type and status, API number and source regulator. Use when the user wants raw permit records across several states or a date window; opa_search_well_permits adds a per-state freshness gate and county/operator search, and opa_get_well_activity summarises counts. Requires a Well Permits subscription (an add-on, or included in some plans); the API answers HTTP 403 without it, and opa_preview_well_permits works on any key. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

end_date.description: Latest permit date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

start_date.description: Earliest permit date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

states.description: Optional US state names or 2-letter codes, e.g. ['TX', 'New Mexico']. Omit for every covered state.

name: opa_list_well_permits
title: List Well Permits
